prompt: A scene is captured at 24 frames per second and runs for 12.5 seconds in the final edit. How many individual frames does the finished scene contain?
teacher_notes: Follow up by asking how the count changes at 30 fps and why that matters for storage estimates.
explanation: Multiply the frame rate by the duration: $(24\text{ frames/s})(12.5\text{ s})=300\text{ frames}$. Frame counts matter when conforming an edit, ordering visual effects work, and estimating media storage.
